title: Post-assassination letters telling Ruth Paine to keep quiet about Oswald

tellings.quote: >> And Arthur Young's wife is telling Ruth, her daughter-in-law, ix nay on the Oswald gay, right?

plain: After the Kennedy assassination, the story goes, Ruth Paine, a Texas woman linked to Lee Harvey Oswald's household, got letters from her mother-in-law, Ruth Forbes Paine Young, telling her to keep quiet about Oswald. The researcher Peter Levenda describes the letters on the show without quoting them, putting it as the wife of a man named Arthur Young telling her daughter-in-law "ix nay on the Oswald gay," pig Latin for "say nothing about the Oswald guy." If true, it would suggest someone close to a key witness wanted her silent from the start.
